Oneliner

Amateur radio FM to Codec-2 transponder and solar sail for de-orbiting.
Description

Amateur radio FM to Codec-2 transponder and solar sail for de-orbiting. The sail of the 2.5-square-meter film sail mechanism technology is a cylinder with a diameter of less than 8 cm and a height of about 3 cm. The amateur radio station onboard will provide telecommand, telemetry and a FM to codec2 digital audio V/U repeater with 67Hz PL tone.
